title: Local notoriety and the Mickey Mouse Club audition
summary: The brothers got newspaper articles and auditioned for Ted Mack and the Mickey Mouse Club in Rochester, where Steve Gadd also auditioned.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see. Were you and your brothers, did you have some notoriety in high school like almost as if you were the quarterback and the wide receiver and the fullback or something on the football team?

No I mean we had some articles in the paper. We auditioned for the Ted Mack Amateur Hour, we auditioned for the Mickey Mouse Club, I remember that. And they put little articles on us in the paper, but it wasn’t really something that went anywhere or followed us anywhere. You know everybody knew that we played music and we were, they knew we were musicians. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
Where did you go to audition for the Mickey Mouse Club?

It was in Rochester, Sibley’s I think, it was at Sibley’s, that building upstairs on one of the floors. Jimmie Dodd came and he was one of the guys that auditioned us. And Steve Gadd of course went, I think Steve won, I think Steve won an audition. I remember Steve Gadd auditioned.
